name: aconnic AG
summary: aconnic AG specializes in delivering advanced wired and wireless communication technologies. The company's offerings encompass comprehensive broadband communication and energy management systems. Additionally, it provides full-spectrum services to clients, including design, engineering, installation, and ongoing maintenance. Operating under the brands Albis-Elcon, Albis Engineering, and Suconi, this firm was established in 2003 and is headquartered in Munich, Germany.
